sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Beginning of Saturday, February 5, 1983, plumber Mike Welch arrived at Cranley Gardens, a long, wide residential street in the north London suburb of Muswell Hill.
sentences.zh: 1983年2月5日星期六一早，管道工迈克·韦尔奇来到了克兰利花园，这是伦敦北部马斯韦尔山郊区一条宽阔的长街。

sentences.en: The neighbourhood was defined by its Edwardian-era houses, most of which were stylish, semi-detached structures with pointed roofs and attractive, well-cared-for gardens.
sentences.zh: 该街区的特色是爱德华时代的房屋，大多是时尚的半独立式建筑，配有尖顶和美观、打理得当的花园。

sentences.en: Twenty-three Cranley Gardens stood out against its neighbouring properties.
sentences.zh: 克兰利花园23号在邻近的房产中显得格格不入。

sentences.en: Its pale blue and white facade was grimy, and the front yard was neglected and overgrown with weeds.
sentences.zh: 它那蓝白相间的门面显得污浊不堪，前院也无人打理，杂草丛生。

sentences.en: Unlike most of the other houses on the street, number 23 had been divided into several separate flats and bedsits that were leased to multiple tenants.
sentences.zh: 与街上大多数房屋不同，23号被分割成了几间独立的公寓和单间，租给了多名租户。

sentences.en: For the past few days, its occupants had been complaining of blocked drains and toilets, necessitating the need for a plumber.
sentences.zh: 过去几天里，住户们一直在抱怨排水管和厕所堵塞，因此必须请管道工来修理。

sentences.en: Mike Welch inspected the drains outside the property and determined the blockage was severe enough to warrant a visit from a specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 迈克·韦尔奇检查了房外的排水管，认定堵塞情况严重，需要专业人员处理。

sentences.en: Jim Alcock, a builder who lived in one of the ground floor flats, called Dynorod,
sentences.zh: 住在底楼公寓的建筑工吉姆·奥尔科克拨打了Dynorod公司的电话，

sentences.en: an emergency plumbing company that used an innovative electromechanical technique to unblock stubborn drains.
sentences.zh: 这是一家紧急管道维修公司，使用一种创新的机电技术来疏通顽固的堵塞物。

sentences.en: Dynorod's earliest available appointment was on Monday February 7, so Jim advised his fellow tenants that they would have to wait two more days for the problem to be fixed.
sentences.zh: Dynorod最早的预约时间是2月7日星期一，所以吉姆通知其他租户，他们还得再等两天才能解决问题。

sentences.en: The Dynorod engineer failed to visit on Monday, but at 6.15pm on Tuesday February 8, the company sent 30-year-old Mike Catron to conduct an inspection.
sentences.zh: Dynorod的工程师周一没能过来，但在2月8日星期二下午6点15分，公司派了30岁的迈克·卡特隆来进行检查。

sentences.en: It was a cold and dreary winter evening, and the ground was covered in sleet.
sentences.zh: 那是一个寒冷阴沉的冬夜，地面覆盖着雨夹雪。

sentences.en: Jim Alcock guided Mike Catron along the side of the house and to the manhole that led to the 12-foot-deep drains beneath.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·奥尔科克带着迈克·卡特隆沿着房子侧面走到检查井旁，井下连接着12英尺深的排水管。

sentences.en: Mike removed the manhole cover and climbed down the iron rungs to see what was causing the blockage.
sentences.zh: 迈克移开了井盖，顺着铁梯爬下去，查看堵塞的原因。

sentences.en: He was instantly hit with a revolting odour and yelled up through the manhole at Jim.
sentences.zh: 他立刻闻到一股令人作呕的恶臭，便对着井口的吉姆大喊。

sentences.en: I haven't been in this job for long, but I know this isn't shit.
sentences.zh: 我干这行时间不长，但我知道这绝不是屎。

sentences.en: Upon closer inspection, Mike realised the drain was blocked by an 8-inch-thick porridge-like substance
sentences.zh: 仔细检查后，迈克发现排水管被一种8英寸厚的粥状物质堵住了，

sentences.en: that contained approximately 40 pieces of what appeared to be greyish-white flesh of various sizes.
sentences.zh: 里面含有大约40块看起来像是大小不一的灰白色肉块。

sentences.en: As he moved around, more of the mysterious substance fell from the pipe that stemmed from the house.
sentences.zh: 随着他的移动，更多神秘物质从连接房子的管道里掉了出来。

sentences.en: By now, several of the tenants had gathered around the manhole to see what was causing the blockage.
sentences.zh: 此时，几名租户已经围在检查井旁，想看看是什么造成了堵塞。

sentences.en: Mike suspected it could be animal remains and suggested it was a matter for the police.
sentences.zh: 迈克怀疑这可能是动物残骸，建议报警处理。

sentences.en: 37-year-old Dennis Nilsen, who lived in the upstairs flat, remarked that it looked like Kentucky Fried Chicken.
sentences.zh: 住在楼上公寓的37岁丹尼斯·尼尔森评论说，这看起来像肯德基炸鸡。

sentences.en: Mike called his supervisor Gary Wheeler to discuss his concerns,
sentences.zh: 迈克打电话给主管加里·惠勒讨论他的担忧，

sentences.en: and the two men agreed to return to the property the following morning to carry out a more thorough inspection in the daylight.
sentences.zh: 两人商定第二天早上回到现场，在光天化日之下进行更彻底的检查。

sentences.en: At 9.15am on Wednesday, February 9, Mike and Gary arrived at 23 Cranley Gardens as planned.
sentences.zh: 2月9日星期三上午9点15分，迈克和加里按计划抵达了克兰利花园23号。

sentences.en: Mike re-entered the manhole and was surprised to see that a majority of the flesh-like substance was no longer there.
sentences.zh: 迈克再次进入检查井，惊讶地发现大部分肉状物质都不见了。

sentences.en: He reached deeper into the drain and fished around until he made contact with something solid.
sentences.zh: 他向排水管深处摸索，直到触碰到一个坚硬的东西。

sentences.en: Upon pulling the object out, he realised he was holding what appeared to be a human knuckle.
sentences.zh: 将物体拉出来后，他意识到自己手里拿着的似乎是一截人类指关节。

sentences.en: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was born on November 23, 1945, in Fraserborough, a mid-sized fishing village in the northeast of Scotland.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·安德鲁·尼尔森于1945年11月23日出生在苏格兰东北部的一个中型渔村弗雷泽堡。

sentences.en: He was one of three children to Betty and Olav Nilsen, who met in 1942, when Olav, who was serving in the Norwegian army,
sentences.zh: 他是贝蒂和奥拉夫·尼尔森的三个孩子之一。这对夫妇于1942年相识，当时奥拉夫正在挪威军队服役，

sentences.en: had been dispatched to Scotland in anticipation of a Nazi invasion.
sentences.zh: 被派往苏格兰以防备纳粹入侵。

sentences.en: Olav's military duties kept him away from his family for long stints at a time, so Betty and the three children lived with her parents in their two-bedroom flat.
sentences.zh: 奥拉夫的军事职责使他长期远离家人，因此贝蒂和三个孩子一直与她的父母住在一套两居室的公寓里。

sentences.en: Olav rarely visited or saw his children, and the couple divorced in 1948.
sentences.zh: 奥拉夫很少探望或见到他的孩子们，两人于1948年离婚。

sentences.en: Betty's parents, Lily and Andrew Fudd, were actively involved in raising their grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂的父母莉莉和安德鲁·福德积极参与抚养外孙们。

sentences.en: Dennis Nilsen had a particularly strong bond with his fisherman grandfather and saw him as his hero and protector.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·尼尔森与当渔民的外祖父感情特别深厚，视他为自己的英雄和保护者。

sentences.en: He relished their long walks together across the nearby sand dunes and golf courses, where his grandfather would carry him on his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 他很享受两人一起走过附近沙丘和高尔夫球场的时光，外祖父常会把他扛在肩上。

sentences.en: In 1951, when Nilsen was six years old, Betty was assigned a council flat of her own, and she and her children moved out to live as a solo family unit for the first time.
sentences.zh: 1951年，尼尔森六岁时，贝蒂分到了一套属于自己的政府公房，她第一次带着孩子们搬出去，作为一个独立的家庭单位生活。

sentences.en: Shortly afterwards, on October 21, 1951,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，在1951年10月21日，

sentences.en: Andrew Fudd was out on a fishing job when he suffered a heart attack and died at sea.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·福德在一次捕鱼作业中突发心脏病，死于海上。

sentences.en: The three children were taken to view their grandfather's lifeless body and were told that he had gone to heaven, a concept that they didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 三个孩子被带去瞻仰外祖父冰冷的遗体，并被告知他去了天堂，这是一个他们无法理解的概念。

sentences.en: Consequently, they thought he was merely sleeping and would soon recover, and Dennis Nilsen was left uncertain and troubled by the idea of death.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们以为他只是睡着了，很快就会好起来，而丹尼斯·尼尔森则对死亡的概念感到困惑和不安。

sentences.en: When adults told him that his grandfather had gone to a better place,
sentences.zh: 当大人们告诉他外祖父去了更好的地方时，

sentences.en: Nilsen believed that death was considered a positive thing.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森认为死亡是一件积极的事情。

sentences.en: In 1954, Betty married a builder named Adam Scott, and the couple had four more children together.
sentences.zh: 1954年，贝蒂嫁给了一位名叫亚当·斯科特的建筑工，两人又生了四个孩子。

sentences.en: Nilsen had never been close with his mother, describing her as cold and unloving, but he grew to admire his stepfather.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森从未与母亲亲近，形容她冷漠且没有爱心，但他逐渐敬佩起继父来。

sentences.en: Despite this, he didn't feel that he belonged in the household and began to withdraw, spending most of his time alone.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他并不觉得自己属于这个家庭，开始变得孤僻，大部分时间都独自一人。

sentences.en: By the age of 10, he was exhibiting some disturbing behaviour.
sentences.zh: 10岁时，他表现出了一些令人不安的行为。

sentences.en: Although he was a self-described animal lover, he took a neighbourhood cat into a disused bathroom, tied a wire around its neck, and strangled it to death.
sentences.zh: 尽管他自称是动物爱好者，但他却把一只邻居家的猫带进一间废弃的浴室，用铁丝勒住它的脖子，将其活活勒死。

sentences.en: He was immediately disgusted by his own actions, later stating,
sentences.zh: 他立刻对自己行为感到厌恶，后来他说道：

sentences.en: I wanted to see the reality and process of killing and death.
sentences.zh: 我想看看杀戮和死亡的现实与过程。

sentences.en: I was not excited by the act.
sentences.zh: 我并没有从这种行为中感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Shortly after this incident,
sentences.zh: 这件事发生后不久，

sentences.en: Nilsen and his family relocated to a larger and more comfortable flat in the village of Stricken, approximately eight miles inland from Fraser Borough.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森一家搬到了弗雷泽堡内陆约八英里处斯特里肯村的一套更大、更舒适的公寓里。

sentences.en: Around the same time,
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，

sentences.en: Nilsen started to recognise that he was physically attracted to males.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森开始意识到自己对男性有生理上的吸引力。

sentences.en: He explored his sexuality by groping his older brother's penis and wrestling with other children.
sentences.zh: 他通过抚摸哥哥的生殖器和与其他孩子摔跤来探索自己的性取向。

sentences.en: On two occasions, he pinned younger boys to the ground and enjoyed feeling a sense of power over them.
sentences.zh: 有两次，他把更小的男孩按在地上，并享受那种掌控他们的权力感。

sentences.en: This realisation about his sexuality left Nilsen with a feeling of shame, as homosexuality was illegal in Scotland during the 1950s and gay people were severely ostracised.
sentences.zh: 这种对自己性取向的认知让尼尔森感到羞耻，因为在20世纪50年代的苏格兰，同性恋是违法的，同性恋者会受到严重的排斥。

sentences.en: By the time Nilsen was 15, he was tired of feeling rejected by his family and the wider community, so he decided to join the army.
sentences.zh: 到15岁时，尼尔森厌倦了被家人和更广泛的社区拒绝的感觉，于是决定参军。

sentences.en: On June 28, 1961, he passed his entrance test and enlisted to serve as an army chef for nine years.
sentences.zh: 1961年6月28日，他通过了入学考试，应征入伍，担任了九年的陆军厨师。

sentences.en: Two and a half months later, he set off for the Army Catering Corps Training Barracks in Aldershot, an English town 42 miles southwest of London.
sentences.zh: 两个半月后，他动身前往位于伦敦西南42英里处的英格兰小镇奥尔德肖特的陆军餐饮部队训练营。

sentences.en: Dennis Nilsen arrived as a frail, introverted and self-conscious adolescent, but the harsh discipline and strict routines of army life saw him evolve into a confident young man.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·尼尔森刚到时是一个虚弱、内向且自卑的少年，但军队严酷的纪律和严格的作息让他成长为一个自信的年轻人。

sentences.en: Determined to match the physical strength of his fellow recruits, he dedicated himself to cross-country training and quickly achieved a high level of fitness.
sentences.zh: 为了达到战友们的体能水平，他全身心投入到越野训练中，很快就达到了高水平的体能。

sentences.en: In May 1964,
he successfully completed his recruitment course at the age of 18.
sentences.zh: 他以18岁的年纪顺利完成了新兵训练课程。

sentences.en: Three months later, he was sent to his first post to work as a catering corps cook in the northwest German city of Osnabrück.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，他被派往第一个驻地，在德国西北部城市奥斯纳布吕克担任餐饮部队厨师。

sentences.en: Nilsen's new comrades were hard workers, but also heavy drinkers, and they introduced him to alcohol.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的新战友们工作努力，但也酗酒成性，他们把他带入了酒精的世界。

sentences.en: Despite having a low tolerance,
sentences.zh: 尽管酒量很小，

sentences.en: Nilsen was soon drinking daily and gained a reputation for often being drunk.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森很快就开始每天喝酒，并因经常喝醉而闻名。

sentences.en: During this time, he also started developing a strong sexual imagination, finding himself drawn to smooth-skinned, boyish-looking men,
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他也开始产生强烈的性幻想，发现自己被皮肤光滑、长相稚气的男人所吸引，

sentences.en: rather than those with larger or muscular physiques.
sentences.zh: 而不是那些体格魁梧或肌肉发达的人。

sentences.en: But as he was well aware of the deep homophobia that existed within the armed forces, including in his own regiment, he suppressed his sexual feelings as best as he could.
sentences.zh: 但由于他深知军队内部（包括他自己的团）存在严重的恐同情绪，他尽可能地压抑自己的性取向。

sentences.en: Privately, he fantasised about one of his sex-starved colleagues finding him passed out drunk and fondling his unconscious body.
sentences.zh: 私下里，他幻想自己那些性饥渴的同事发现他醉倒后，对他失去知觉的身体上下其手。

sentences.en: Eventually, this desire became so strong that Nilsen sometimes pretended to pass out in the hope that someone would take advantage of him.
sentences.zh: 最终，这种欲望变得如此强烈，以至于尼尔森有时会假装醉倒，希望有人能占他的便宜。

sentences.en: On July 22, 1966,
20-year-old Nilsen was promoted to corporal, and six months later, in January 1967, he was posted to Al-Mansura Detention Centre in Arden, a port city in the Republic of Yemen.
sentences.zh: 20岁的尼尔森被提升为下士。六个月后，即1967年1月，他被派往也门共和国港口城市亚丁的曼苏拉拘留中心。

sentences.en: Mansura was a military prison that held terrorist detainees, and it was frequently under attack from rioters.
sentences.zh: 曼苏拉是一所关押恐怖分子的军事监狱，经常遭到暴徒袭击。

sentences.en: Arden was a dangerous place, and soldiers were often ambushed and killed while out on patrol, with dead bodies often littering the countryside.
sentences.zh: 亚丁是个危险的地方，士兵们在巡逻时经常遭到伏击并被杀害，尸体往往横陈在郊外。

sentences.en: Despite these threats,
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些威胁，

sentences.en: Nilsen claimed he engaged in risky behaviour by going out drinking in town, then hitchhiking back to the barracks.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森声称他从事着冒险行为，去城里喝酒，然后搭便车回军营。

sentences.en: On July 21, 1967,
Nilsen was deployed to the
sentences.zh: 尼尔森被部署到

sentences.en: Trucial Lomant Scouts Mess in Sharjah, a city in the Persian Gulf.
sentences.zh: 波斯湾城市沙迦的特鲁西尔阿曼侦察兵食堂。

sentences.en: During his time there, he witnessed several horrific events, including a plane crash victim being brought back to the base in pieces, and the death of a drinking companion
sentences.zh: 在那里期间，他目睹了几起可怕的事件，包括一名空难受害者的残骸被带回基地，以及一名酒友的死亡，

sentences.en: who accidentally broke his neck after falling from a Land Rover.
sentences.zh: 那人从路虎车上摔下来，意外折断了脖子。

sentences.en: Despite these incidents,
sentences.zh: 尽管发生了这些事件，

sentences.en: Nilsen's time in Sharjah was generally positive.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森在沙迦的时光总体上是积极的。

sentences.en: He had the advantage of a private room and began to further explore his sexuality.
sentences.zh: 他拥有单人间的优势，并开始进一步探索自己的性取向。

sentences.en: He placed a large horizontal mirror beside his bed and imagined that his reflection belonged to someone else, enjoying the fantasy most when he lay still
sentences.zh: 他在床边放了一面巨大的横向镜子，想象镜子里的倒影属于别人，当他静静地躺着，

sentences.en: and appeared to be asleep or unconscious.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是睡着或失去知觉时，他最享受这种幻想。

sentences.en: On January 15, 1968,
Nilsen returned to the United Kingdom and was posted to the Seton Barracks in Plymouth, a port city on England's south coaSt.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森回到英国，被派往英格兰南海岸港口城市普利茅斯的塞顿军营。

sentences.en: One night, he was watching television in his room when he heard whimpering noises and went to investigate.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他正在房间里看电视，听到呜咽声，便去查看。

sentences.en: He discovered that several young privates had brought a local barmaid back to the barracks and watched as they took turns raping her.
sentences.zh: 他发现几名年轻列兵把一名当地酒吧女招待带回了军营，并看着他们轮流强奸她。

sentences.en: To his own shame,
sentences.zh: 出于羞愧，

sentences.en: Nilsen went back to his room without intervening.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森没有干预，回到了自己的房间。

sentences.en: In a separate incident,
sentences.zh: 在另一起事件中，

sentences.en: Nilsen and a young private were drinking heavily on a long train journey when the private passed out.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森和一名年轻列兵在长途火车上喝得酩酊大醉，那名列兵醉倒了。

sentences.en: Nilsen carried him to the bathroom and intentionally propped him in such a way that the jerking motion of the train caused his unconscious head to knock against the toilet bowl.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森把他扛到厕所，故意以一种姿势支撑着他，让火车的颠簸使他失去知觉的头部撞击马桶边缘。

sentences.en: He then sexually assaulted the private and considered raping him, but stopped when other passengers started banging on the door.
sentences.zh: 随后他性侵了这名列兵，并考虑强奸他，但当其他乘客开始敲门时，他停了下来。

sentences.en: Afterwards, when the private regained consciousness,
sentences.zh: 事后，当那名列兵恢复知觉时，

sentences.en: Nilsen pretended nothing had ever happened.

sentences.zh: 比利跟了过来，表示他无处可去，于是尼尔森邀请他到自己的公寓暂住。

sentences.en: Once they arrived at Melrose Avenue,
sentences.zh: 到达梅尔罗斯大道后，

sentences.en: Nilsen strangled Billy with his bare hands and disposed of his body underneath the floorboards.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森用双手勒死了比利，并将他的尸体处理在地板下。

sentences.en: Despite Billy's transient lifestyle, he regularly contacted his girlfriend Donna and his mother back home in Scotland and the two grew concerned when he stopped calling.
sentences.zh: 尽管比利生活漂泊，但他经常与女友唐娜和苏格兰老家的母亲联系，当他停止通话时，两人感到担忧。

sentences.en: His mother contacted both the London Metropolitan Police and the Salvation Army to report him missing.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲联系了伦敦大都会警察局和救世军报案称他失踪。

sentences.en: But there were already 40 other men named Billy Sutherland on the missing persons register.
sentences.zh: 但失踪人口登记册上已经有40个名叫比利·萨瑟兰的人了。

sentences.en: Nilsen now had three bodies hidden underneath his floorboards that he needed to get rid of, those of Kenneth Ockenden, Martin Duffy and Billy Sutherland.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森现在地板下藏着三具尸体需要处理：肯尼斯·奥肯登、马丁·达菲和比利·萨瑟兰。

sentences.en: One Sunday afternoon in August, he retrieved all three corpses and laid them out on his kitchen floor.
sentences.zh: 8月的一个周日下午，他把这三具尸体都挖了出来，平放在厨房地板上。

sentences.en: They were in an advanced state of decomposition, covered in maggots and emitting a foul odour.
sentences.zh: 尸体已经高度腐烂，爬满了蛆虫，散发出恶臭。

sentences.en: Nilsen drank several glasses of rum and then masturbated next to his victims in what he interpreted as his way of saying goodbye.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森喝了几杯朗姆酒，然后在受害者身旁自慰，他认为这是他告别的方式。

sentences.en: Using his sharpest kitchen knives,
sentences.zh: 用最锋利的厨刀，

sentences.en: Nilsen employed the butchery skills he had learned in the army to dissect each of the bodies into several parts.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森运用他在军队学到的屠宰技巧，将每具尸体肢解成几部分。

sentences.en: It was a difficult and physically demanding process, during which Nilsen vomited several times.
sentences.zh: 这是一个困难且耗费体力的过程，期间尼尔森呕吐了好几次。

sentences.en: In order to remove the flesh from the skulls, he boiled the heads of his victims in a large cooking pot on the stove.
sentences.zh: 为了剔除头骨上的肉，他把受害者的头颅放在炉子上的大锅里煮。

sentences.en: He put the internal organs into plastic bags and stuffed them between the double fencing in his backyard to be eaten by insects and animals.
sentences.zh: 他把内脏装进塑料袋，塞进后院的双层围栏之间，让昆虫和动物吃掉。

sentences.en: He placed the remaining body parts in plastic bags and stuffed them inside some old suitcases that had been left at the flat by a previous tenant.
sentences.zh: 他把剩下的身体部位装进塑料袋，塞进前任租客留在公寓里的一些旧行李箱中。

sentences.en: Not all of the body parts would fit, so Nilsen hid a bag containing the arms and hands of one victim underneath a bush in his backyard.
sentences.zh: 由于装不下所有部位，尼尔森把一个装有其中一名受害者手臂和手的袋子藏在后院的灌木丛下。

sentences.en: He then took the suitcases to his garden shed and constructed a low brick wall around them.
sentences.zh: 然后他把行李箱搬到花园棚屋，并在周围砌了一道矮砖墙。

sentences.en: To conceal the stench, he placed a few sticks of deodorant over the suitcases and covered them with bricks and stacked newspapers.
sentences.zh: 为了掩盖恶臭，他在行李箱上放了几根除臭剂，并用砖块和成堆的报纸盖住它们。

sentences.en: As Nilsen had sole use of the garden, he didn't bother to lock the shed.
sentences.zh: 由于花园归尼尔森独用，他懒得锁上棚屋。

sentences.en: Over the following months,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，

sentences.en: Nilsen continued to frequent London's pubs, where he met several unsuspecting men whom he brought back to his Melrose Avenue flat.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森继续频繁出入伦敦的酒吧，在那里他遇到了几名毫无戒心的男子，并将他们带回梅尔罗斯大道的公寓。

sentences.en: While his memory of this period was hazy, his victims included an Irish labourer aged between 27 and 30 years old, a slim man of either Filipino or Mexican descent,
sentences.zh: 虽然他对这段时期的记忆模糊，但受害者包括一名27至30岁的爱尔兰劳工、一名菲律宾或墨西哥裔的瘦削男子、

sentences.en: an emaciated homeless man whom he met on Charing Cross Road, and a long-haired hippie he encountered in London's West End.
sentences.zh: 一名在查令十字路遇到的消瘦流浪汉，以及一名他在伦敦西区遇到的长发嬉皮士。

sentences.en: As he'd done with his earlier victims, he strangled each of them and then hid their bodies under his floorboards.
sentences.zh: 像对待之前的受害者一样，他勒死了他们每一个人，然后把尸体藏在地板下。

sentences.en: On November 10, 1980,
Nilsen was drinking with some people at the Golden Lion pub in Soho when the group struck up a conversation with Douglas Stewart, a 26-year-old from the town of Thurso
sentences.zh: 尼尔森在苏豪区的金狮酒吧与人喝酒，当时这群人与道格拉斯·斯图尔特聊了起来，他是一名来自瑟索镇的26岁青年，

sentences.en: on Scotland's north coaSt.
sentences.zh: 位于苏格兰北海岸。

sentences.en: Although the Golden Lion had a reputation as a gay bar,
sentences.zh: 尽管金狮酒吧以同性恋酒吧闻名，

sentences.en: Douglas was there because it served his favourite Scottish beer.
sentences.zh: 但道格拉斯去那里是因为那里供应他最喜欢的苏格兰啤酒。

sentences.en: He drank and chatted with the group until closing time, at which point Nilsen suggested they continue the party at his flat.
sentences.zh: 他与这群人喝酒聊天直到打烊，这时尼尔森建议他们去他的公寓继续聚会。

sentences.en: Once Douglas was out on the street, he realised he was the only person who had taken Nilsen up on his offer.
sentences.zh: 当道格拉斯走到街上时，他意识到自己是唯一一个接受尼尔森邀请的人。

sentences.en: Although he was now hesitant, he thought it would be rude if he didn't continue on, so the two headed to Nilsen's flat alone.
sentences.zh: 虽然他现在有些犹豫，但他觉得如果不继续下去会很不礼貌，于是两人独自前往尼尔森的公寓。

sentences.en: Once there, they each drank two pints of beer and Nilsen invited Douglas to join him in bed.
sentences.zh: 到达后，他们各喝了两品脱啤酒，尼尔森邀请道格拉斯和他一起上床。

sentences.en: The Scotsman declined and instead went to sleep in an armchair.
sentences.zh: 这位苏格兰人拒绝了，转而在扶手椅上睡着了。

sentences.en: Two hours later,
sentences.zh: 两小时后，

sentences.en: Douglas awoke to find that his feet had been tied to the legs of the chair and that the necktie he'd taken off earlier was now fastened around his throat.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯醒来，发现自己的脚被绑在椅腿上，而他之前摘下的领带正勒在喉咙上。

sentences.en: Suddenly,
sentences.zh: 突然，

sentences.en: Nilsen was on top of him, pushing his knee down hard into Douglas's cheSt.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森压在他身上，用膝盖用力顶住道格拉斯的胸口。

sentences.en: Douglas fought back, scratching Nilsen hard enough under one eye to draw blood and eventually pinned him to the ground.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯奋力反抗，在尼尔森的一只眼睛下方抓出了一道血痕，最终将他按倒在地。

sentences.en: Nilsen loudly shouted, take my money, take my money, before quietly and calmly telling Douglas,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森大声喊道：“拿走我的钱，拿走我的钱”，然后平静而低声地对道格拉斯说：

sentences.en: I could kill you.
sentences.zh: “我可以杀了你。”

sentences.en: The struggle dissipated and Douglas placated Nilsen by apologising and helping to wipe the blood from his face.
sentences.zh: 挣扎平息了，道格拉斯通过道歉并帮他擦掉脸上的血迹来安抚尼尔森。

sentences.en: He stayed for another drink, then fled to the nearest telephone box to call the police.
sentences.zh: 他又喝了一杯酒，然后逃到最近的电话亭报警。

sentences.en: Shortly after, an officer arrived at Nilsen's flat, but Nilsen provided a starkly different version of advance.
sentences.zh: 不久后，一名警察到达尼尔森的公寓，但尼尔森提供了一个截然不同的说法。

sentences.en: The police didn't notice the scratch below his eye and promptly left, concluding the fight had likely been nothing more than,
sentences.zh: 警察没有注意到他眼下的抓痕，很快就离开了，断定这场争斗很可能只是，

sentences.en: a lover's tiff.
sentences.zh: “情侣间的吵架”。

sentences.en: The next day, they tried to contact Douglas to obtain a further statement, but were unable to locate him.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他们试图联系道格拉斯以获取进一步的陈述，但无法找到他。

sentences.en: No further action was taken.
sentences.zh: 没有采取进一步行动。

sentences.en: By December of 1980,
Nilsen now had the remains of seven victims on his property.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的房产里已经有七名受害者的遗骸。

sentences.en: The bodies of Kenneth Ockenden,
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯·奥肯登、

sentences.en: Martin Duffy and Billy Sutherland were in the suitcases in the shed.
sentences.zh: 马丁·达菲和比利·萨瑟兰的尸体在棚屋的行李箱里。

sentences.en: Three of the unnamed victims were stored underneath the floorboards and one was in the cupboard.
sentences.zh: 三名未具名的受害者被存放在地板下，还有一人在橱柜里。

sentences.en: Realising he was running out of room and needed to dispose of his victims permanently,
sentences.zh: 意识到空间不足且需要永久处理掉受害者，

sentences.en: Nilsen retrieved the four unidentified bodies and dismembered them using a kitchen knife.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森取出了四具身份不明的尸体，用菜刀将他们肢解。

sentences.en: He placed the limbs, heads and torsos into large plastic garbage bags, put them back under the floorboards and then disposed of the organs and entrails
sentences.zh: 他把四肢、头颅和躯干装进大型塑料垃圾袋，放回地板下，然后把内脏和肠子

sentences.en: in his backyard for animals to devour.
sentences.zh: 扔在后院让动物吃掉。

sentences.en: That evening, he prepared a large bonfire in the area of Wasteland just beyond his back garden.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他在后花园外的一片荒地上准备了一场大篝火。

sentences.en: He used sections of a recently felled poplar tree as the base and stacked pieces of wooden furniture that had been discarded by his neighbours on top.
sentences.zh: 他用最近砍倒的一棵杨树的树干作为底座，上面堆放了邻居丢弃的木制家具。

sentences.en: When he was finished, the structure was five feet tall and had a large hole in the centre.
sentences.zh: 完成后，结构有五英尺高，中间有一个大洞。

sentences.en: Nilsen retired to bed and resumed his plan at 6.45 the following morning while it was still dark.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森上床睡觉，并于次日清晨6点45分天还没亮时继续他的计划。

sentences.en: He retrieved the garbage bags from beneath the floorboards, wrapped them inside two large carpets and dragged them out to the bonfire.
sentences.zh: 他从地板下取出垃圾袋，用两条大毯子裹住，拖到篝火旁。

sentences.en: Next, he fetched the suitcases from the garden shed.
sentences.zh: 接着，他从花园棚屋取回了行李箱。

sentences.en: Those that had been stacked on top were still intact and easy to drag into the centre of the bonfire, but the ones at the bottom had been crushed and fell to pieces
sentences.zh: 堆在上面的那些还完好无损，很容易拖到篝火中心，但底部的那些已经被压坏，在他试图抬起时

sentences.en: when he tried to lift them.
sentences.zh: 散架了。

sentences.en: Bits of rotting flesh scattered onto the ground, which he had to pick up by hand to add to the pyre.
sentences.zh: 腐烂的肉块散落在地上，他不得不亲手捡起来扔进火堆。

sentences.en: When all of the garbage bags, suitcases and stray pieces had been thrown into the centre,
sentences.zh: 当所有的垃圾袋、行李箱和散落的碎片都被扔进中心后，

sentences.en: Nilsen loaded the fire with newspaper and threw an old car tyre on top to disguise the inevitable smell of burning flesh.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森在火堆里塞满报纸，并扔上一个旧汽车轮胎，以掩盖焚烧尸体不可避免的臭味。

sentences.en: He squirted the base with lighter fuel and set the pile alight.
sentences.zh: 他往底部喷了些打火机油，点燃了火堆。

sentences.en: The fire burned throughout the day, with Nilsen monitoring it closely at all times and adding extra wood as required.
sentences.zh: 火烧了一整天，尼尔森全程密切监视，并根据需要添加额外的木材。

sentences.en: A few children from the neighbourhood stopped by to watch it burn, but Nilsen warned them away.
sentences.zh: 几个邻居家的孩子停下来观看火势，但尼尔森把他们赶走了。

sentences.en: By the time the fire eventually died down, one of his victim's skulls was still recognisable, so Nilsen used the garden rake to crush it into a fine powder.
sentences.zh: 当火势最终熄灭时，其中一名受害者的头骨依然清晰可辨，于是尼尔森用花园耙子把它捣成了细粉。

sentences.en: He then covered the ashy remains of the fire with bricks, disinfected the floor of the garden shed, took a bath, and headed out to the Salisbury pub in London's West End.
sentences.zh: 随后他用砖块盖住灰烬，消毒了花园棚屋的地板，洗了个澡，然后前往伦敦西区的索尔兹伯里酒吧。

sentences.en: There, he met a young man with whom he had a one-night stand.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他遇见了一个年轻人，并与对方发生了一夜情。

sentences.en: Christmas and the new year passed without incident, but during the first few months of 1981,
sentences.zh: 圣诞节和新年平安度过，但在1981年的头几个月里，

sentences.en: Nilsen was the victim of a series of robberies.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森成了连环抢劫案的受害者。

sentences.en: His camera and projector were stolen from his flat and he was also mugged one night while staggering home drunk from the pub.
sentences.zh: 他的相机和投影仪在公寓里被盗，有一天晚上他从酒吧喝得醉醺醺地摇晃着回家时，还遭到了抢劫。

sentences.en: The assailant stole 300 pounds, the equivalent of one month's wages.
sentences.zh: 袭击者抢走了300英镑，相当于他一个月的工资。

sentences.en: To make ends meet,
sentences.zh: 为了维持生计，

sentences.en: Nilsen had to apply to the Department of Employment
sentences.zh: 尼尔森不得不向就业部

sentences.en: Benevolent Fund for an advance on his wages, which he was mortified about.
sentences.zh: 福利基金申请预支工资，这让他感到非常羞愧。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, his landlords were encouraging him to vacate the Melrose Avenue property as they considered him a difficult, uncooperative and obstructive tenant.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的房东一直催促他搬离梅尔罗斯大道的住所，因为他们认为他是一个难缠、不配合且爱找麻烦的房客。

sentences.en: They told Nilsen he would have to leave temporarily while renovations were underway, but he refused, saying that he wouldn't be intimidated into giving up his rights as a tenant.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉尼尔森，在翻修期间他必须暂时搬走，但他拒绝了，称自己不会被恐吓而放弃作为房客的权利。

sentences.en: One day in June 1981, he returned home from work to discover that his entire flat had been vandalised.
sentences.zh: 1981年6月的一天，他下班回家发现整个公寓都被人破坏了。

sentences.en: His television, record player and mirror were smashed to pieces and his furniture, linen and clothing had all been smeared in a tar-like substance, destroying everything
sentences.zh: 他的电视机、唱片机和镜子被砸得粉碎，家具、床单和衣服都被涂上了一种类似焦油的物质，毁坏了一切，

sentences.en: except the suit he was wearing.
sentences.zh: 除了他身上穿的那套西装。

sentences.en: Nilsen reported the incident to the police who took a statement, but the person responsible was never identified.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森向警方报了案，警方做了笔录，但肇事者始终没被查出来。

sentences.en: When Nilsen's colleagues at the job centre found out, they pulled their money together and presented him with a cheque for 85 pounds, the equivalent of about
sentences.zh: 当尼尔森在就业中心的同事们得知此事后，他们凑了钱，送给他一张85英镑的支票，这相当于

sentences.en: 600 Australian dollars in today's currency.
sentences.zh: 按今天的货币计算大约600澳元。

sentences.en: That same month,
sentences.zh: 就在同一个月，

sentences.en: Nilsen made several attempts to further his career.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森多次尝试在事业上寻求晋升。

sentences.en: First, he submitted a request to attend management committee meetings as part of his role as a union official, but the request was denied without explanation.
sentences.zh: 首先，他申请以工会官员的身份参加管理委员会会议，但该请求未获解释就被拒绝了。

sentences.en: He then applied for a transfer to the overseas workers section of the job centre, a department which helped place foreign workers in employment.
sentences.zh: 随后，他申请调往就业中心的海外劳工部门，该部门负责帮助外国劳工寻找工作。

sentences.en: Nilsen's manager denied this request, writing in a rejection letter,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的经理拒绝了这一请求，并在拒绝信中写道：

sentences.en: Your manner in relationships with your colleagues is usually outspoken and often overbearing.
sentences.zh: 你在与同事相处时，态度通常过于直率，且往往盛气凌人。

sentences.en: I am concerned that despite your undoubted desire to provide an effective service to our customers, your manner with the public on overseas workers section might cause offence.
sentences.zh: 我担心，尽管你确实渴望为我们的客户提供有效的服务，但你在海外劳工部门对待公众的态度可能会引起冒犯。

sentences.en: Nilsen was furious, but continued in his current role.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森大发雷霆，但还是继续从事他目前的工作。

sentences.en: Throughout the first half of 1981, he also claimed three more victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在1981年上半年，他又杀害了三名受害者。

sentences.en: One was an 18-year-old blue-eyed Scottish man who he met at the Golden Lion in Soho and challenged to a drinking competition.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是18岁的蓝眼睛苏格兰男子，他在苏活区的金狮酒吧遇见对方，并向其发起了饮酒比赛。

sentences.en: Another was a man in his early 20s from Belfast who he met in the West End, and the other was a 20-year-old skinhead who was covered in tattoos,
sentences.zh: 另一人是来自贝尔法斯特的20岁出头的男子，他在西区遇见了对方；还有一人是20岁的光头党，身上布满了纹身，

sentences.en: one of which was a dotted line
sentences.zh: 其中一个纹身是

sentences.en: across his neck accompanied by the words, cut here.
sentences.zh: 脖子上的一条虚线，旁边写着“从这里切开”。

sentences.en: Like the other attacks, the men were killed by strangulation and kept for several days to fulfil
sentences.zh: 和其他袭击一样，这些人都是被勒死的，并被留置了几天以满足

sentences.en: Nilsen's sexual desires before being dismembered and buried under the floorboards.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的性欲，随后被肢解并埋在地板下。

sentences.en: At 7.30am on Thursday,
sentences.zh: 周四早上7点30分，

sentences.en: September 17,
Nilsen was walking to work when he saw a young man slumped against a garden wall a few houses down from his flat.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森在步行去上班的路上，看到一个年轻人瘫倒在他公寓几户人家外的一堵花园墙边。

sentences.en: The man was 24-year-old
sentences.zh: 那个人是24岁的

sentences.en: Malcolm Barlow, an orphan from the Yorkshire town of Rotherham who had spent the majority of his youth in foster homes and hospitals for the mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆·巴洛，一个来自约克郡罗瑟勒姆镇的孤儿，他的大部分青春时光都在寄养家庭和精神病院度过。

sentences.en: He was of low intelligence, epileptic and also a compulsive liar who often induced seizures in order to gain sympathy.
sentences.zh: 他智力低下，患有癫痫，还是个惯性说谎者，经常为了博取同情而诱发癫痫发作。

sentences.en: Malcolm relied on welfare benefits and sometimes turned to sex work to earn an income.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆依靠福利救济金生活，有时也会通过性交易来赚取收入。

sentences.en: He typically slept in hostels or with people who picked him up off the street.
sentences.zh: 他通常睡在收容所里，或者睡在那些把他从街上捡回来的人家里。

sentences.en: Malcolm told Nilsen that the pills he was taking to treat his epilepsy had caused his legs to give way and he was unable to walk.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆告诉尼尔森，他治疗癫痫的药物导致他双腿无力，无法行走。

sentences.en: Nilsen picked Malcolm up and helped support him as they walked back to his flat.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森扶起马尔科姆，搀扶着他走回了自己的公寓。

sentences.en: There, he made Malcolm a cup of coffee before going to the nearest payphone to call an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他给马尔科姆冲了一杯咖啡，然后去附近的公用电话亭叫救护车。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, the paramedics arrived and took Malcolm to the Park Royal Hospital where he received treatment and was released the next day.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，医护人员赶到，将马尔科姆送往皇家公园医院，他在那里接受了治疗，并于次日出院。

sentences.en: On Friday,
sentences.zh: 周五，

sentences.en: September 18,
Nilsen returned home from work to find Malcolm sitting on his doorstep.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森下班回家，发现马尔科姆正坐在他的门阶上。

sentences.en: He invited him inside, cooked him a meal and the two sat down to watch television together.
sentences.zh: 他邀请他进屋，为他做了顿饭，两人坐下来一起看电视。

sentences.en: Nilsen started drinking but refused to give Malcolm any alcohol in case it interfered with his medication.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森开始喝酒，但拒绝给马尔科姆任何酒精饮料，以免影响他的药物疗效。

sentences.en: Malcolm insisted one or two drinks would be fine and Nilsen reluctantly agreed.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆坚持说喝一两杯没关系，尼尔森勉强同意了。

sentences.en: After drinking two rum and cokes,
sentences.zh: 喝了两杯朗姆酒兑可乐后，

sentences.en: Malcolm then fell asleep on the sofa.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆便在沙发上睡着了。

sentences.en: An hour later,
sentences.zh: 一小时后，

sentences.en: Nilsen tried to wake Malcolm by slapping him in the face but there was no response.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森试图通过扇耳光叫醒马尔科姆，但对方毫无反应。

sentences.en: He contemplated whether or not to call the paramedics again but was worried that if he did, the police might become involved.
sentences.zh: 他考虑是否要再次叫救护车，但担心如果这样做，警察可能会介入。

sentences.en: After 20 minutes of consideration, he wrapped his hands around Malcolm's neck and strangled him to death.
sentences.zh: 经过20分钟的思索，他双手掐住马尔科姆的脖子，将其勒死。

sentences.en: He then finished his drink and went to bed.
sentences.zh: 随后他喝完了剩下的酒，上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: The next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.en: Nilsen dragged
sentences.zh: 尼尔森拖着

sentences.en: Malcolm's body into the kitchen, placed him under the sink and left for work.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆的尸体进入厨房，把他放在水槽下，然后去上班了。

sentences.en: When later reflecting on the murder to author
sentences.zh: 后来在向作家

sentences.en: Brian Masters,
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·马斯特斯回忆这起谋杀案时，

sentences.en: Nilsen said,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森说：

sentences.en: I'm sorry that he managed to find me again.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾他竟然又找到了我。

sentences.en: In late September
sentences.zh: 1981年9月下旬，

sentences.zh: 一位代表尼尔森房东的房地产经纪人提议将梅尔罗斯大道住所东北方向约五英里处的一套独立公寓租给他。

sentences.en: As an added incentive, the landlords offered to pay him
sentences.zh: 作为额外的激励，房东提出支付他

sentences.en: £1,000 compensation for the difficulties he had endured over the preceding months.
sentences.zh: 1000英镑的赔偿金，以补偿他过去几个月所遭受的困难。

sentences.en: Nilsen was driven to see the flat at 23 Cranley Gardens in Muswell Hill and accepted the offer on the spot.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森被开车带去看了位于马斯韦尔山克兰利花园23号的公寓，并当场接受了提议。

sentences.zh: 搬家时间定在周一，

Nilsen spent the weekend prior packing up his few belongings and disposing of the remaining bodies.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森利用之前的周末打包了他为数不多的行李，并处理掉了剩下的尸体。

sentences.en: On Saturday
sentences.zh: 周六，

sentences.en: October 3, he built one final bonfire in the wasteland behind his garden using unwanted furniture and rubbish to again create a large construction with a hollow centre.
sentences.zh: 10月3日，他在花园后面的荒地上用废弃的家具和垃圾堆起了最后一个篝火，再次搭建了一个中心中空的巨大结构。

sentences.en: In the early morning hours of Sunday
sentences.zh: 周日凌晨，

sentences.en: October 4, while it was still dark outside, he dragged
sentences.zh: 10月4日，趁着外面天还没亮，他拖着

sentences.en: Malcolm Barlow's body to the wasteland and into the centre of the fire.
sentences.zh: 马尔科姆·巴洛的尸体来到荒地，放进了火堆中心。

sentences.en: He then retrieved the body parts of the three unidentified victims from underneath the floorboards and added them to the pile.
sentences.zh: 随后，他从地板下取出了那三名身份不明受害者的遗骸，并把它们加到了火堆上。

sentences.en: After setting the fire alight, he watched as it burned.
sentences.zh: 点火后，他注视着火势燃烧。

sentences.en: When one of his neighbours came out to ask what was going on,
sentences.zh: 当其中一位邻居出来询问发生了什么事时，

sentences.en: Nilsen responded that he was burning his rubbish before the big move.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森回答说，他在搬家前清理并焚烧垃圾。

sentences.en: On Monday morning,
sentences.zh: 周一早上，

sentences.en: Nilsen checked the remnants of the fire and noticed a large pile of ashes and small bone fragments remained.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森检查了火堆的残余物，发现剩下了一大堆灰烬和细小的骨头碎片。

sentences.en: Using a garden roller, he flattened the pile and crushed the bones into unrecognisable pieces.
sentences.zh: 他用花园滚筒压平了灰堆，将骨头碾成了无法辨认的碎片。

sentences.en: He then remembered he had hidden the hands and arms of one victim under a bush in his backyard and retrieved the bag that contained the body parts.
sentences.zh: 接着他想起自己曾把一名受害者的双手和手臂藏在后院的灌木丛下，于是取回了装有这些尸块的袋子。

sentences.en: After using a shovel to break the bones into smaller fragments, he threw them over the fence into the wasteland.
sentences.zh: 用铲子将骨头敲成更小的碎片后，他把它们扔过了围栏，抛向荒地。

sentences.zh: 不久后搬家工人到达，

sentences.en: Nilsen loaded up his belongings and his beloved dog,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森装好了行李，带上了他心爱的狗，
